doc.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Getting the first engineer credit on Tristano's Jazz label single
summary: Tristano's 'Ju Ju' / 'Pastime' single on his own Jazz label (Jazz 101) credited Rudy, the first engineer credit.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And you said that on that recording that he made, actually released the ’78 himself, that he credited you?

Yeah that one was called, “Ju Ju”, ’78, single. “Pastime” I think was the name of the other song, and he started his own label called “Jazz.” He put my name as an engineer on the label, and that was first time any engineer gotten credit.
Right, I looked up the record and it’s called “Jazz 101”, so that was the first record.
